[splitting of the universal cover]

Source: petersen:page-0373 ↗ cor:pet-ch9-betti1-bound-flat-torus ↗ thm:pet-ch9-bochner-vanishing-1forms 1. ch9:9.6.1Let compact $(M^n,g)$ have $b_1(M)=k$ and $\operatorname {Ric}\ge 0$. Prove the product decomposition \[ (\widetilde M,g)=(N,h)\times (\mathbb R^k,g_{\mathbb R^k}). \] Also construct a case with $b_1<n$ but $(\widetilde M,g)=(\mathbb R^n,g_{\mathbb R^n})$.
